title: STAR-T-GATE Inbox #13 repository self-audit disposition

dispositions.notes: Fresh-current-main reconciliation changes the original audit materially. Stale and intentional references were separated from genuine placeholder defects; confirmed BIM Director placeholders were repaired. Remaining reference-integrity work should be validator-driven.
Every ATS now identifies a machine-resolvable governing object; requirement_id remains a bounded secondary locator where applicable. CI validates the governing links.
TIVERIT-CONFORMANCE-COVERAGE-001 publishes generated informational coverage. Missing ATS or ETS is a visibility state, not a blanket conformance failure; CI checks freshness.

Resolved through SECURITY-MINDED-INFORMATION-GATE.md and the external-standard gateway. ISO 19650-5:2020 Edition 1 is registered by identity/status only, based on official ISO public metadata showing the 2020 publication remains current after confirmation in 2025. The gate does not claim ISO 19650-5 implementation or compliance. It requires project security applicability to resolve as applicable, no requirement identified, or unresolved; unknown is never treated as permission. Applicable requirements route to the governing project/organizational controls, and exact external requirements require authorized evidence before mapping.
The corpus needs a citable release/version model before formal cutover. This is repository governance, not domain doctrine. Define release semantics separately from per-object migration status.
Absence of explicit licensing/contribution terms is a real publication/adoption risk. Curator must not select a license on behalf of the owner. Record and escalate for owner decision.

Operational-phase coverage must be declared as in-scope future work or explicit non-goal. Do not infer ISO 19650-3 requirements into the normative corpus until TIVERIT operational scope is explicitly governed.
Verify the claimed ETS identifier and role-resolution-map classification against current main, then repair or relocate only where repository architecture supports the change.

curator_rule: Inbox evidence remains non-authoritative. Mechanical repairs may be promoted when they preserve existing authority; external-standard applicability is routed through the canonical gateway, while project controls, licensing and release authority require their proper governed sources.
